aiOverview.content: The 2026 Masters Tournament (April 6–12) can be watched on TV via CBS and ESPN, with extensive streaming on Paramount+, Masters.com, and the Masters App. Featured group and Amen Corner coverage streams all day, while CBS provides weekend afternoon coverage.
